episodes.title: The Infinity Thief
episodes.summary: To regain his detective status, Cole Ellis, a demoted by-the-book cop, is assigned to work with Max Mitchell, a spirited con artist whose charismatic street smarts could help catch an elusive thief.

episodes.title: Show Me the Murder
episodes.summary: A harmless porch pirate case leads Max and Ellis to stumble upon the murder of a cutthroat sports agent.

episodes.title: Howl to Get Away With Murder
episodes.summary: Things go from quaint to creepy when Max and Ellis look into the disappearance of a butcher in a small rural town; Max quizzes Ellis on his personal life.

episodes.title: Strangers on a Wave
episodes.summary: After a surfer gets shot and washes up on the beach, Ellis goes under cover and Max puts on her detective hat to unravel a criminal plot worthy of Hitchcock.

episodes.title: The Accountant of Monte Cristo
episodes.summary: When Ellis's federal agent ex-girlfriend loses an accountant scheduled to testify against the mob, she enlists their help to find him before the accountant ends up sleeping with the fishes.

episodes.title: Dead of Night
episodes.summary: When the leads of THE most popular vampire show on TV become the target of a stalker, Max and Ellis enter the world of showbiz where the behind-the-scenes drama is even wilder than what's on screen.

episodes.title: Con with the Wind
episodes.summary: George gets a 3-day pass from jail to spend with Max but the urge to pull one more con is real. Ellis helps a troubled youth charged with a B&E after he discovers it's a teen his brother used to know.

episodes.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Therapized Mind
episodes.summary: When a celebrated therapist and best-selling author is murdered, a bickering Max and Ellis go undercover as a married couple at her wellness retreat and discover more than their chakras.

episodes.title: Inside (Con) Man
episodes.summary: Max visits the bank to access her safe deposit box but instead becomes a hostage in a dangerous robbery. Ellis defies Chief Li's orders to wait for the Tactical Response Team, knowing Max is inside.

episodes.title: Romancing the Egg
episodes.summary: Ellis is drawn into a case involving Max, her ex, and a world-famous Imperial egg, where a cat-and-mouse heist tests their friendship, their partnership, and their trust in each other.

episodes.title: Con in 60 Seconds
episodes.summary: Begrudgingly, Ellis comes to terms with Max's betrayal knowing she risked it all to share info about his brother's killer; now assigned to a new case, they dive into a high-speed street racing ring.

episodes.title: Once a Con a Time in the West
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis saddle up for a wild west adventure as they track down the attempted murderer of a ranch family's stud horse and uncover a dark family secret.

episodes.title: The Lorne Identity
episodes.summary: A paranoid biomedical engineer with a case of amnesia comes to Ellis for help leading the team down a trail of conspiracies, corruption and secret codes.

episodes.title: Dial A for Alibi
episodes.summary: Stuck at home with a sprained ankle and a pair of binoculars, Max is convinced she has witnessed a murder while snooping on the condo across the street.

episodes.title: Catch Me If You Con
episodes.summary: Max's childhood bestie visits, pulling her into her old con ways. While Ellis investigates the murder of a former tennis pro, the BFFs go undercover to find the killer.

episodes.title: Seance and Sensibility
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis investigate a mysterious murder among an eccentric family where everyone is a suspect with riches on the line. Max adopts a psychic persona and holds a séance to summon the true killer.

episodes.title: The Big Bang Theory
episodes.summary: When Chief Li and Max are trapped in the police station , Ellis tries to find a way to get them out safely without letting emotion cloud his judgement.

episodes.title: Death By Design
episodes.summary: When the head of a popular streetwear clothing brand is found dead, Max and Ellis find themselves investigating a murder within the world of haute couture, fashion models and overworked assistants.

episodes.title: Barking Bad
episodes.summary: A murdered dog show judge leads Max and Ellis to a traveling dog competition to sniff out the killer. Ellis and his cat Marc move in temporarily with Max and Ricky while Ellis' boat is under repair.

episodes.title: Our Lip (Fillers) Are Sealed
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis go undercover, joining the cast and crew of a reality show to find out who murdered its star. In a world of scandal, deceit and lip-filler parties, every cast member is under suspicion.

episodes.title: Bride and Doom
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis are pulled into the undercover world of espionage and counterintelligence when a bride becomes the target of an unusual murder attempt on her wedding day.

episodes.title: Clouds In My Eyes
episodes.summary: Ellis gets new information that leads him to a jazz club and possibly the person responsible for Daniel's death. Max poses as a singer at the club to gather intel. George goes before the parole board.

episodes.title: Sunrise Sunset
episodes.summary: Ellis makes a shocking discovery about the criminal kingpin responsible for Daniel's death, and who is protecting him. Max, George and Ricky try to solve the cryptic clues hidden in Ashford's office.

episodes.title: Rack 'Em Up
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis hunt a pool shark's killer, while Max's mom returns from the grave with a vengeful crime lord trailing her who puts the whole family in the danger.

episodes.title: Quit Playing Games (With My Life)
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis probe a fiery murder on her favorite 90s boy band's reunion tour, sifting through frosted tips and oversized egos to unmask the killer.

episodes.title: M.D.-CEASED
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis investigate the case of an ER's top doctor who's found stabbed, leading them through a maze of medical rivalries, angry patients, and a killer hiding in plain sight.

episodes.title: Dead Weight
episodes.summary: When a bodybuilding champion is crushed under his own weights, Max & Ellis dive into the world of muscle, sweat, and protein shakes, uncovering a secret double life that proves fatally heavy.

episodes.title: Hot Tub Death Machine
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis investigate a locked room mystery after the shocking death of a high powered fixer electrocuted in her penthouse hot tub, where she was the only one present at the time.

episodes.title: Return of the Corkscrew Killer
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis visit a small town marking a grisly murder spree anniversary, only to face a copycat killer, forcing them to team up with the lone survivor of the original killer.

episodes.title: Yurt So Vain
episodes.summary: Max and Ellis go undercover at a creepy digital detox retreat after a former member turns up dead, trading phones for flower crowns to expose a deadly guru-led cult.

episodes.title: The Hostage Always Rings Twice
episodes.summary: Max finds herself playing hostage negotiator when a kidnapped woman calls 911 using a makeshift phone, unraveling a complex web involving an affair, gambling and a race against time at a NASCAR event

episodes.title: Fast Crimes at Ridgemont High
episodes.summary: Ellis faces his awkward past when a notoriously cruel classmate is poisoned at their high school reunion, making everyone a suspect - especially Ellis himself.

episodes.title: Now You Steal Me...
episodes.summary: The Varga endgame explodes as Max is kidnapped, forcing Ellis to team up with her con artist family for the Varga job, culminating in a final, deadly confrontation with the mastermind himself.
